test_bucket_op: test the bucket operation on a fairseq2 data pipeline with a fixed bucket size
test_bucket_partial_drop: test the bucket operation with the drop parameter to control partial final bucket behavior
test_bucket_state_save_restore: test saving and restoring pipeline state using state_dict and load_state_dict on a bucketed pipeline
test_bucket_validation: test that bucket raises a ValueError when bucket_size is zero
test_bucket_reset: test resetting a bucketed data pipeline to restart iteration from the beginning
